title: Ruby Sailing

services.name: RUBY Sailing
services.desc: “We had a wonderful, and windy, adventure on Father's Day and our 10th Anniversary. It's a family tradition. We sailed on the RUBY before we were married. It's a great way to go.” - The Stratton Family Beer, Wine, and soft drinks are for sale on board for $6 per bottle of beer and $6 per glass of wine, $3 for soft drinks. If you bring your own wine or champagne the corkage fee is $20 per bottle (20% is added to bar tabs). RUBY is licensed by the Cemetery Board to do ash scattering in the Bay. We have special morning rates. For 6 or fewer passengers the fee is $400, 6 to 15 passengers $700, and 15 to 28 passengers $800. Afternoon or ocean scatterings are $600 per hour, 2 hour minimum.
